codex_round.weakest_assumption_self_audit: Buffer zone keep25/entry20 expected TO reduction ~30% (Codex precedent). Achieved 14.2% only. Possible reasons: (a) NEW alpha churn rate so high that keep25 = entry20 + 5 padding ineffective; (b) Volatility-Skew composite alpha has cross-section that doesn't favor name continuity; (c) Composite_z mixing z_1715 + z_NEW creates rank instability month-to-month.
